title: Polynomial-time closure under truncation
statement: Let $o\colon\{0,1\}^*\to\mathbb N$ and $S\colon\{0,1\}^*\to\{0,1\}^*$ be polynomial-time computable. Then the function sending each bit string $y$ to the string obtained by deleting the first $o(y)$ bits of $S(y)$ is polynomial-time computable.
